direction_as_read: mixed: oral glutathione raises body stores and changed skin melanin measures in small trials; clinical outcomes are unresolved or null
summary: Most labels print reduced or L-glutathione at 50 to 500 mg a serving. Three are liposomal (294002, 184557, 315656), two are S-acetyl-L-glutathione at 100 mg (241943, 323065), one prints Setria (227921), and one is named Glutathione-SR (284225). One RCT meets the reading bar for reduced glutathione: 250 or 1,000 mg/day for 6 months raised body stores in healthy adults (24791752), a biomarker result. Insulin sensitivity rose in 20 obese men on 1000 mg/day (33740389). A 500 mg acne trial was not significant on markers (41014073), and a trial in children with cystic fibrosis was null on its primary (32960827). Reviews of skin outcomes are split (39444151, 30895708). Abstracts only.
question_for_clinician: Does one 6-month RCT showing raised glutathione stores at 250 and 1000 mg/day (24791752), with no clinical outcome, support any credit for reduced glutathione labels at 50 to 500 mg a serving? Agent recommendation: no credit. Liposomal, S-acetyl and Setria labels are outside this question.

read_not_used.30895708: Systematic review of four skin studies; calls the evidence inconclusive; no pooled estimate. Cited as a conflict in the skin context.
read_not_used.37935462: Stool microbiome analysis from a diabetic trial; 500 mg/day; no clinical outcome.
read_not_used.34150674: Oral liposomal glutathione in type 2 diabetes for 3 months; dose not in abstract; outcomes are oxidative stress, cytokines and in vitro granulomas.
read_not_used.41897500: Single-dose bioavailability crossover in 14 healthy adults and a 30-day single-arm phase of a micellar product; not efficacy. Calls Setria liposomal.
read_not_used.41559937: Open-label single-dose pharmacokinetics of a liposomal product in 12 healthy subjects plus cell work; not efficacy.
read_not_used.39436083: One group pretest-posttest in 26 hemodialysis patients; uncontrolled.
read_not_used.42683004: EFSA safety opinion on S-acetyl glutathione as a novel food; not an efficacy trial; for the clinician list.
